Append-only: add new pairs at the end with the next rg- id; retire a wrong pair in place with "retired": true and a reason in notes; never delete, rewrite, or reorder past entries. Slice decision procedures and negative examples live in SLICES.md; declared_slice_counts counts non-retired pairs and must be updated with every append. Every live multi-hop pair records consequence_memory_id and its measured baseline_consequence_rank; the loader rejects a live multi-hop pair whose recorded rank is not worse than MULTI_HOP_BASELINE_K -- see SLICES.md for the measurement protocol. It also records bridge_entity and bridge_status (graph-side verification); name-only bridges are a closed exception list pinned in the loader, and every new pair must be shared-entity.
